purpose: Create reference-numbered working copies for all 51 PPARD candidates under the Stage56a technical-amendment contract while preserving raw RCSB coordinates.

sequence_gate.alignment: global amino-acid alignment; match 2, mismatch -1, gap-open -10, gap-extend -0.5; deterministic first optimal alignment
sequence_gate.unmapped_polymer_residue_numbering: negative synthetic IDs reserved only in the working copy so they cannot collide with reference-numbered residues

interpretation_boundary: Stage56b changes only residue identifiers in derived working copies according to frozen sequence correspondence. It does not modify raw RCSB files, coordinates, coordinate thresholds, docking data, protected data, QUBO objectives, or hardware authorization.
